documents.title: Approval For Raising Of Funds For An Aggregate Amount Of Up To And Not Exceeding ? 1,800 Crores Through One Or More Public Or Private Offering Including A Qualified Institutions Placement ('QIP') Of Equity Shares Or Other Eligible Securities To Eligible Investors.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,391 crores for Q2 FY27, up 61% year-on-year, with EBITDA of INR 189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin. The company generated INR 136 crores of operating cash flow in H1 FY27, reversing an outflow from the previous year, while net debt declined to INR 531 crores. Management reiterated its strategic focus on expanding exports, lightweight jewelry, advance gold models, and studded jewelry to drive return on capital employed. Due to regulatory guidelines, management refrained from providing new forward guidance, while maintaining that past margin guidance remains on track. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited presented its financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, reporting H1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹4,403.5 crore and PAT of ₹234.3 crore.

guidance.claim: Management stated that it is not permitted to give forward-looking guidance under SEBI guidelines.
guidance.quote: Under SEBI guidelines, we are not supposed to give forward-looking guidance.

guidance.claim: The company noted that its historical guidance for PAT margin remains on track.
guidance.quote: Due to compliance restriction, we cannot comment on future guidance, but our past margin percentage guidance remains on track.

guidance.claim: The company previously guided for FY27 revenue of approximately ₹5,000 crore.
The company previously guided for a PAT margin of approximately 3.5% for FY27.
Following a preferential allotment in FY24, the company guided for ₹3,000 crore revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27-28.
guidance.quote: Following the preferential allotment from marquee investors in FY24, we guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28 (vs FY24 revenue of ₹1,745 Cr).

guidance.claim: The company's current FY27 revenue target is INR 8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold aims to achieve revenue between INR 18,000 crores and INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach a 20% share in exports in coming years.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting good sales export as we have guided that we will go to 20% exports in coming years.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold targets an overall PAT margin close to 5%.
guidance.quote: And our overall PAT margin will be close to 5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed a significant shift in customer buying preferences across karatages.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported rapid growth in its B2B segment alongside an industry shift from unorganized to organized sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: In addition to the B2C segment, our B2B business is also growing very fast, and there is a significant shift from unorganized to organized sector, which is happening on the B2B space as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Increasing presence of organised manufacturers in the Indian jewellery industry creates a favourable backdrop for established players.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian jewellery industry continues to witness an increasing presence of organised manufacturers within the overall market, creating a favourable backdrop for companies with established capabilities, scale, and customer relationships.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 2,013 crores, representing 78% year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: First, our consolidated revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at INR2,013 crores, registering a strong 78% year-on-year growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry increased to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference.
demand_outlook.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

demand_outlook.claim: Natural and lab-grown studded jewelry currently accounts for 2% of revenues.
demand_outlook.quote: Third, studded jewelry. Natural and lab-grown studded jewelry is currently at 2% of revenues, and it contributes close to 0.3% in gross margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in the London expo helped build a prospective order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores in U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold opened its international office in Dubai during Q2 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q2 FY26, we opened our international office in Dubai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Shri Rishabh Gold at a valuation below INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Shri. Rishabh Gold (Mangalsutra) acquired at less than INR10 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold acquired Purvi Gold for INR 9 crores against a book value of INR 6 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Purvi Gold (Uncut Diamonds) acquired at INR9 crores versus book value of INR6 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,50,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold established a Dubai office as part of its growth initiatives.
The company's current production capacity is sufficient until 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028.

capex_expansion.claim: Post 2028, capex for a new facility on a leased model is expected to be INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue reached INR 2,391 crores, marking a 61% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue was INR2,391 crores, up 61% year-on-year and 18.8% over Q1.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q2 FY27 rose to INR 229 crores with gross margin expanding to 9.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit was INR229 crores, up 87%. Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA reached INR 189.8 crores in Q2 FY27 at a 7.9% margin.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin, up 90%.

margins_costs.claim: Reported PAT for the quarter stood at INR 129 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Reported PAT was INR129 crores, up 93%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating costs increased to 1.6% of sales due to investments in personnel and governance functions.
margins_costs.quote: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales, as we invested in people: a CEO, a larger design team, and stronger audit and finance functions.

margins_costs.claim: An increased share of value-added business served as the main driver of gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Implementation of ERP software to track operational KPIs resulted in a reduction of gold loss.
margins_costs.quote: Implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 from 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Second, we are seeing a clear improvement in the quality of our revenue and profitability. Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 increased to INR 157 crores, representing a margin of 7.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT crossed INR 100 crores for the first time during Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: Advance Gold model contributes approximately 90 to 100 basis points to revenue and gross margin.
margins_costs.quote: First, the Advance Gold contributes close to 90 to 100 bps in revenue and gross margin, since this flows into the gross profit.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly volumes for Shri Rishabh Gold expanded from 20-25 kg up to 150 kg post-acquisition.
orders_capacity.quote: Their monthly volumes have grown from about 20 kg to 25 kg to 150 kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced metal business accounts for nearly 16% of total company volume.
orders_capacity.quote: Nearly 16% of our volume comes from advanced metal, which employs no capital of ours.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold has a total production capacity of 1.2 tons and operated at approximately 60% utilization in the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company closed Q1 FY27 with a net working capital cycle of approximately 60 days.
orders_capacity.quote: As a result, we are closing this quarter at approximately 60 days of our net working capital cycle.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt stood at INR 531 crores at the end of September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt was INR531 crores at September end, and versus INR550 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated operating cash flow of INR 136 crores in H1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Most importantly, we generated INR136 crores of operating cash flow in H1, against an outflow of INR101 crores in H1 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will draw no salaries starting from FY27, receiving payouts exclusively via dividends from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flows turned positive at close to INR 30 crores in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our cash flows from operations turned positive at close to INR30 crores in Q1 FY27 compared to negative operating cash flows till the end of '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt stood at INR 540 crores at the end of the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters adopted a zero-salary compensation model starting FY27, linking rewards entirely to dividends paid from operating cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening remain the top priority for capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company took an exceptional charge of INR 7.35 crores during Q2 FY27 related to a subsidiary fraud incident.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sky Gold recovered INR 3.35 crores of the total INR 10.70 crores involved in the subsidiary fraud incident.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of the INR10.70 crores involved, INR3.35 crores has been recovered, and the balance is fully provided this quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened gold price volatility has created margin pressures across the jewelry sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced an incident involving INR 10.7 crores, of which INR 3.5 crores has been recovered through legal action.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

management_commitments.claim: The promoters committed to purchasing the land themselves if no final commitment is received from an external buyer within 20 to 30 days.
management_commitments.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters committed to taking a salary only when the business generates positive operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting from FY27, taking payouts solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving INR 8,100 crores in revenue for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold aspires to build a revenue scale of INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to build a net debt-free business by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our aspiration is to build a company that is net debt-free, operations with a highly efficient balance sheet, maintains industry-leading working capital metrics and consistently converts a significant portion of its earnings into sustainable operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: The company committed to scaling exports to 20% in coming years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting good sales export as we have guided that we will go to 20% exports in coming years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
